description:
At Significance, we believe the best results come from investing in great people. As a woman-owned consulting firm supporting federal civilian and Department of Defense customers, we bring together talented professionals who are passionate about solving complex challenges and making a meaningful impact.
We're proud of the culture we've built - one rooted in trust, collaboration, respect, and genuine relationships. Our people are empowered to share ideas, grow their careers, and deliver exceptional results while supporting missions that matter. It's a culture we're proud of, and one that has earned us recognition as a Washington Business Journal Best Place to Work for seven consecutive years.

Required Skills:
 •    Active or interim DoD SECRET security clearance; ability to maintain clearance eligibility for the duration of assignment.
•    U.S. Citizenship (required by contract).
•    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
•    1–3 years of professional RPA, software automation, or related development experience, including demonstrated hands-on experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting software, automation, or RPA solutions.
•    Hands-on experience with UiPath or comparable RPA development experience, with the ability to develop proficiency in UiPath Studio and Orchestrator.
•    Foundational understanding of RPA concepts, including process automation, workflow design, exception handling, testing, debugging, and production support.
•    Working knowledge of Python and SQL or comparable programming/scripting experience.
•    Understanding of software development fundamentals, including programming logic, testing, debugging, reusable development, and version control.
•    Ability to analyze documented business processes and translate functional requirements into technical automation tasks with guidance from senior technical resources.
•    Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation, including process flows, development documentation, test results, and user instructions.
•    Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
•    Ability to work independently on defined development tasks while collaborating effectively within a team-oriented program environment.

Desired Skills:
 •    Hands-on development experience with UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, Robot/Assistant, or related UiPath technologies.
•    UiPath Certified Professional Automation Developer Associate or other relevant UiPath certification.
•    Experience with Microsoft Power Automate or other enterprise automation platforms.
•    Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI services, or cloud-based application and automation services.
•    Exposure to generative AI, large language models (LLMs), agentic AI concepts/frameworks, intelligent document processing, or AI-enabled automation.
•    Experience integrating applications or automation solutions using REST APIs, databases, or other system interfaces.
•    Familiarity with Databricks or cloud-based data platforms.
•    Experience working with enterprise data sources such as SQL databases, SharePoint, Excel, and structured/unstructured data.
•    Experience with Git, GitLab, or other version-control and collaborative software development platforms.
•    Prior experience supporting Department of the Navy, NAVFAC, DoW, DoD, or another federal government organization.
•    Familiarity with Navy real property, facilities, asset management, financial management, or data reconciliation processes.
•    Experience supporting financial statement audit remediation, internal controls, data quality, or data reconciliation efforts in a federal environment.
•    Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies in a government or professional services environment.

At Significance, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. 
 
We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a comprehensive and generous benefits package.
